goal: If you were the CEO of NVIDIA today, what would you do next and why? Identify the key opportunities, risks and trends and produce prioritised, evidence-backed strategic recommendations.

plan.focus: Emerging AI and GPU technologies
Regulatory and supply chain risks
Market positioning and customer sentiment
Financial performance and investment trends
Competitive threats and market share shifts

top_findings.title: AMD and Intel Regaining GPU Market Share

recommendations: Accelerate R&D investments in next-generation AI chips to maintain competitive edge against AMD, Intel, and new entrants.
Diversify global supply chain and distribution strategies to mitigate risks from export controls and regulatory restrictions in key markets.
Enhance collaboration with open-source communities to address potential threats from FOSS and maintain relevance in the AI ecosystem.
Expand into AI development tools and profiling software to capture a larger share of the AI development market.
Leverage the AI boom of 2026 to attract investment and position NVIDIA as a leader in the semiconductor industry.
Monitor and adapt to regulatory changes in the AI and semiconductor industries to ensure compliance and minimize disruptions.
Strengthen relationships with key clients and partners in the AI inference industry to mitigate profitability risks.
